modules.name: Francois Markovian
modules.description: 8-step, 6-track trigger sequencer whose playhead jumps between steps by a hand-set Markov matrix, with X/Y evolve, freeze and a clock divider

modules.name: Interlock
modules.description: Six triggers in, six out: a 6x6 influence grid where each track firing raises or lowers the others' chances on the next steps, with memory and amount

modules.name: Governor
modules.description: Feedback controller: listens to up to 6 trigger tracks and outputs control CVs that hold their density and variety at a target

modules.name: Rewrite
modules.description: Per-track pattern grower: seeds a bar of triggers, then rewrites each hit and rest by its own rules every few bars, with lock, hold, rewind and poly linking
